NEUTRAL.strategy: Neutral types have no offensive advantages but also few disadvantages. They're reliable and consistent. Focus on raw power and utility moves rather than type matchups.
NEUTRAL.counterplay: Martial types hit Neutral for super effective damage. Ghost types are completely immune to Neutral moves, making them hard counters.
NEUTRAL.teamTips: Pair with Ghost types to cover your Martial weakness. Neutral moves provide consistent neutral damage against most opponents.

FIRE.strategy: Fire types excel at offense with strong STAB options. Great for breaking through defensive Steel and Ice types. Burn status cripples physical attackers.
FIRE.counterplay: Water types completely wall Fire and hit back super effectively. Earth and Stone types also resist Fire while threatening with STAB moves.
FIRE.teamTips: Pair with Water or Earth types to cover your weaknesses. Fire's Steel-breaking ability makes it valuable for team composition.

WATER.strategy: Water types are well-rounded with solid offense and defense. They counter popular Fire and Earth types effectively. Access to healing moves adds longevity.
WATER.counterplay: Electric and Grass types threaten Water with super effective damage. Dragon types resist Water while having strong neutral coverage.
WATER.teamTips: Water pairs excellently with Grass to form a defensive core. Consider Electric immunity via Earth-type teammates.

ELECTRIC.strategy: Electric types are fast and hit hard. Excellent against Water and Air types. Paralysis status slows down faster opponents.
ELECTRIC.counterplay: Earth types are completely immune to Electric moves and hit back with STAB Ground attacks. Grass and Dragon resist Electric well.
ELECTRIC.teamTips: Air types pair well with Electric as they're immune to Earth moves. Watch out for Earth-type switch-ins.

GRASS.strategy: Grass types counter Water and Earth but have many resistances to overcome. Status moves like Sleep and Leech provide utility beyond damage.
GRASS.counterplay: Fire, Ice, and Air types all threaten Grass with super effective damage. Venom and Insect provide additional offensive pressure.
GRASS.teamTips: Grass benefits from Fire-type partners to handle Ice and Insect threats. Water/Grass cores are classic defensive pairings.

ICE.strategy: Ice types are powerful Dragon-slayers and threaten Air and Earth types. Freeze status can completely disable opponents. Glass cannon - hit hard but fragile.
ICE.counterplay: Fire and Martial types crush Ice defensively and offensively. Metal and Stone also resist Ice while dealing super effective damage.
ICE.teamTips: Ice needs support for its many weaknesses. Pair with Water types who can switch into Fire attacks. Excellent late-game cleaner.

MARTIAL.strategy: Martial types are offensive powerhouses that break through Steel and Stone walls. High Attack stats and strong priority moves make them dangerous.
MARTIAL.counterplay: Psyche and Mystic types resist Martial and hit back super effectively. Air types also check Martial while being immune to Earth.
MARTIAL.teamTips: Martial appreciates Shadow or Ghost partners to handle Psyche types. Stone and Metal breaking is invaluable for team support.

VENOM.strategy: Venom types excel at wearing down opponents with Poison status and Toxic damage. Great Mystic counters. Defensive typing with few weaknesses.
VENOM.counterplay: Earth and Psyche types hit Venom super effectively. Steel is completely immune to Poison status and resists Venom moves.
VENOM.teamTips: Venom pairs well with Earth types in a defensive core. Essential for checking Mystic types on many teams.

EARTH.strategy: Earth types are premiere Electric immunities and hit five types super effectively. Excellent defensive and offensive presence.
EARTH.counterplay: Water, Grass, and Ice all threaten Earth with super effective STAB. Air types are immune to Earth moves entirely.
EARTH.teamTips: Earth is essential for Electric immunity. Pair with Air or Grass types to cover Water weakness. Foundational team member.

AIR.strategy: Air types are immune to Earth moves and outspeed many opponents. Excellent Martial and Insect checks with strong offensive STAB.
AIR.counterplay: Electric and Stone types threaten Air with super effective moves. Ice also hits Air super effectively.
AIR.teamTips: Air pairs excellently with Electric types. Ground immunity is valuable, but watch for Ice coverage moves.

PSYCHE.strategy: Psyche types hit Martial and Venom super effectively. Often have high Special Attack and access to utility moves. Mind games with prediction.
PSYCHE.counterplay: Shadow and Ghost types resist Psyche and hit back super effectively. Insect types also threaten Psyche with super effective STAB.
PSYCHE.teamTips: Psyche struggles against Shadow pursuit tactics. Pair with Mystic types to handle Shadow threats.

INSECT.strategy: Insect types threaten Psyche and Shadow while being underestimated. Access to priority moves and utility like Sticky Web.
INSECT.counterplay: Fire, Air, and Stone all threaten Insect with super effective damage. Many types resist Insect moves.
INSECT.teamTips: Insect appreciates Steel partners to handle Fire and Stone threats. Excellent Psyche and Shadow counters.

STONE.strategy: Stone types hit four common types super effectively. Good physical bulk but many common weaknesses. Stealth Rock support is valuable.
STONE.counterplay: Water, Grass, Martial, Earth, and Metal all hit Stone super effectively. Many physical attackers can break through Stone.
STONE.teamTips: Stone needs significant defensive support. Pair with Water or Grass types to cover weaknesses. Entry hazard setter.

GHOST.strategy: Ghost types have two immunities (Normal and Fighting) making them excellent switch-ins. Ghost STAB is largely unresisted.
GHOST.counterplay: Shadow types resist Ghost and hit back super effectively. Ghost mirrors are coinflips. Normal types are immune to Ghost.
GHOST.teamTips: Ghost provides invaluable immunities to Martial. Pair with Mystic or Normal types to handle Shadow threats.

DRAGON.strategy: Dragon types have excellent stats and few weaknesses. Dragon STAB hits most types neutrally. Late-game sweepers.
DRAGON.counterplay: Ice and Mystic types threaten Dragon with super effective damage. Metal resists Dragon moves. Dragon mirrors favor the faster Dragon.
DRAGON.teamTips: Dragon benefits from Steel partners to handle Ice and Mystic threats. Classic 'Dragon + Steel + Fairy' cores are powerful.

SHADOW.strategy: Shadow types are Psyche immunities and Ghost counters. Pursuit traps fleeing Psyche types. Strong utility with Knock Off and Sucker Punch.
SHADOW.counterplay: Martial and Mystic types both threaten Shadow with super effective STAB. Insect also hits Shadow super effectively.
SHADOW.teamTips: Shadow is essential for Psyche and Ghost control. Pair with Martial or Venom types for a dark core.

METAL.strategy: Metal types have the most resistances (11 types) and Venom immunity. Excellent defensive pivots. Strong Mystic counters.
METAL.counterplay: Fire, Martial, and Earth all hit Metal super effectively. Metal's low Speed means it often takes hits before acting.
METAL.teamTips: Metal is the premier defensive type. Pair with Water or Earth types to cover Fire weakness. Essential for Mystic control.

MYSTIC.strategy: Mystic types are Dragon immunities and threaten Martial, Dragon, and Shadow. Excellent offensive and defensive typing.
MYSTIC.counterplay: Venom and Metal types resist Mystic and hit back with STAB. Fire also resists Mystic moves.
MYSTIC.teamTips: Mystic is essential for Dragon control. Pair with Metal or Venom types for mutual support. 'Dragon + Fairy + Steel' is a classic core.
